stem: Nepal's first transnational Petroleum Pipeline starts from which place in Bihar?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: Nepal’s first multinational petrol pipeline starts from Motihari in Bihar and goes up to Amlekhganj in Nepal. This 69 km. long pipeline was inaugurated on 10 September, 2019 by Nepal’s then Prime Minister K. P. Sharma Oli and India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

stem: What was the power capacity availability in the Bihar state in the year 2019?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: At the time of the question, option (a) was the correct answer. As per the Bihar Economic Survey, 2024–25, according to the state’s generation plan, the estimated peak availability is 7157 MW in 2024–25 and 7463 MW in 2025–26.

stem: Per capita energy consumption of the state of Bihar is :

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: In the context of the time of the question, option (a) was the correct answer. As per the Bihar Economic Survey, 2024–25, per capita electricity consumption in Bihar increased from 203 kWh in 2015 to 348 kWh in 2023. As per the provisional figures for 2024, per capita electricity consumption in Bihar has become 363 kWh.

stem: The latest annual per capita consumption of electricity in Bihar is –

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: As per the Bihar Economic Survey, 2020–21, per capita electricity consumption in Bihar in 2019–20 was 332 kWh, which is the lowest level of electricity consumption in the country, whereas as per the Bihar Economic Survey, 2024–25, for 2024 (provisional), per capita electricity consumption in Bihar is 363 kWh.

stem: Kahalgaon, Kanti, Barh and Nabinagar are the centres for which of the following?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Kahalgaon (Bhagalpur), Kanti (Muzaffarpur), Barh (Patna) and Nabinagar (Aurangabad) are centres of thermal power in Bihar.

stem: In which of the following years was the Bihar state Hydroelectric Power Corporation was established ?
expl: The Bihar State Hydroelectric Power Corporation (BHPC: Bihar State Hydroelectric Power Corporation) was established in 1982. It was an undertaking of the Government of Bihar. It worked for the development, installation, coordination, financing, and operation, etc. of all types of renewable energy projects in Bihar (such as hydroelectric, solar, wind, biomass, etc.).
